name: RenderDocument
title: Render Document
description: Capture a page, or a region of it, as an image. A diagram, a chart, a table as it looks, a slide, a signature block
whenToUse: Turn part of a document into a picture: a whole page, or a region given by its page and box, as a PNG. For anything a person or an Agent should SEE rather than read: a UML or process diagram, an org chart, a fund structure chart, a chart whose numbers cannot be read off, a table too irregular to tidy, a slide, a signature. The box usually comes from a parsed document's figure, table or section provenance. Reads PDFs and images on the platform's own service; a Word or PowerPoint file has to be converted to PDF first.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: The file: { downloadUrl, key, etag } as S3 File Content emits

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: { base64, mimeType: image/png, width, height, page, box }: the rendered region

fileUrl.title: File URL
fileUrl.description: A URL the service can fetch the file from, usually a presigned link wired from an upstream file node

page.title: Page
page.description: The page to render, counted from 1

box.title: Region
box.description: The region as JSON { x0, y0, x1, y1 } in points with the origin top-left, as a parsed document's provenance gives it. Leave blank for the whole page.

dpi.title: DPI
dpi.description: Resolution of the image. 150 reads cleanly on a screen; 300 for print.

authRequired.title: Require sign-in
authRequired.description: Only a signed-in caller may run this step. Leave off and it runs for whoever the workflow's trigger admitted, which is the usual answer.

authRole.title: Require role
authRole.description: A claim the caller's account must carry, as noun:verb (finance:approve, payments:refund). Leave blank to require only that they are signed in.

package.name: documents
package.packageFile:
# DOCUMENTS — the platform's own document service (services/documents, a Python service beside
# umap): a file in, its structure out. Text in reading order, every table as rows, every figure
# as an image with its caption, every ordered list, the dates a document carries, and where on
# which page each sits. docs/unoverse/data/documents/README.md.
#
# ONE DOOR, ONE NODE: ParseDocument, RenderDocument, InventoryFolder, ReadCover, ReadValues. Each is a JOB on
# the service (start, poll, collect), which is the LlamaParse shape, so the poll capability does
# the waiting. A door does one job, so one can be improved or replaced without touching what
# calls it: a census before reading, a cover before filing, a parse when the whole is wanted.
#
# THE HOST IS THE ENGINE, at loopback (`scope.engineUrl`, :4101), which forwards to the service
# (routes/documents.ts) the way it reaches umap. A node's call must be https or loopback
# (allowedHosts.ts refuses a plaintext request to any other host), and a compose service on the
# Docker network is neither; the engine holds the service's address so no node and no file does.

name: documents
displayName: Documents
description: >-
  Read a file into its structure with the platform's document service. Text, tables as rows,
  figures, lists, dates, provenance
version: 0.1.0
category: ingest
logoUrl: https://res.cloudinary.com/sonik/image/upload/v1751366180/gravity/icons/gravityIcon.png

features:
  - Parse PDF, Word, slides, spreadsheets, HTML and images into one typed structure
  - Tables as rows with units parsed, figures as images, ordered lists as steps
  - Render any page or region as an image
  - "Inventory a folder: kinds, pages, dates, duplicates"
  - "Read a cover: what each file is about and the date it states, from named cells, no model"
  - "Read values: the figures a parsed document stated, refused whole when they do not add up to what it says about itself"

allowedHosts:
  # LOOPBACK ONLY, numeric form (the pattern rejects a bare "localhost"): every call goes to the
  # engine's own listener, which forwards to the service. No third-party host, ever.
  - 127.0.0.1

requires:
  executorVersion: ">=1.6.0"
  transport: [json]
  # Every door is a job: without `poll` an executor would settle on the receipt and emit the job
  # id as the answer.
  poll: true

files.api/run.yaml:
- name: job
  method: POST
  url: "return scope.engineUrl + '/documents/render'"
  transport: json

  body:
    file_url: "{{ config.fileUrl }}"
    file_name: "return String(config.fileName || '').trim() || undefined"
    page: "return Number(config.page) || 1"
    # A JSON string in config, parsed here: invalid JSON fails the run loudly rather than rendering
    # the wrong region. Blank is the whole page.
    box: "return String(config.box || '').trim() ? JSON.parse(String(config.box)) : undefined"
    dpi: "return Number(config.dpi) || undefined"

  timeoutMs: 60000

  error:
    when: "return !!response.detail || !!response.error"
    message: "return response.error || (typeof response.detail === 'string' ? response.detail : JSON.stringify(response.detail))"

  poll:
    url: "return scope.engineUrl + '/documents/jobs/' + response.id"
    until: "return response.status === 'COMPLETED'"
    failed: "return response.status === 'FAILED'"
    message: "return response.error || ('render ' + response.status)"
    intervalMs: 2000
    maxAttempts: 150
files.config.yaml:
configSchema:
  type: object
  required: [fileUrl, page]
  properties:
    fileUrl:
      type: string
      title: File URL
      description: A URL the service can fetch the file from, usually a presigned link wired from an upstream file node
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    fileName:
      type: string
      title: File Name
      description: The name with its extension
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    page:
      type: number
      title: Page
      description: The page to render, counted from 1
      default: 1
    box:
      type: string
      title: Region
      description: >-
        The region as JSON { x0, y0, x1, y1 } in points with the origin top-left, as a parsed
        document's provenance gives it. Leave blank for the whole page.
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    dpi:
      type: number
      title: DPI
      description: Resolution of the image. 150 reads cleanly on a screen; 300 for print.
      default: 150
"ui:order": [fileUrl, fileName, page, box, dpi]
files.interface.yaml:
inputs:
  - name: file
    type: object
    description: "The file: { downloadUrl, key, etag } as S3 File Content emits"
    required: false

outputs:
  - name: image
    type: object
    description: "{ base64, mimeType: image/png, width, height, page, box }: the rendered region"

credentials: []

type: RenderDocument
kind: PromiseNode

name: Render Document
category: Documents
color: "#0F766E"
logoUrl: https://res.cloudinary.com/sonik/image/upload/v1751366180/gravity/icons/gravityIcon.png

description: >-
  Capture a page, or a region of it, as an image. A diagram, a chart, a table as it looks, a

whenToUse: >-
  Turn part of a document into a picture: a whole page, or a region given by its page and box,
  as a PNG. For anything a person or an Agent should SEE rather than read: a UML or process
  diagram, an org chart, a fund structure chart, a chart whose numbers cannot be read off, a

capabilities:

files.test.yaml:
testData:
  config:
    fileUrl: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf
    fileName: dummy.pdf
    page: 1
    dpi: 72
  inputs:
    file:
      downloadUrl: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf
      etag: dummy-pdf-etag
  expect:
    image: "return typeof output.image.base64 === 'string' && output.image.base64.length > 100 && output.image.width > 0 && output.image.mimeType === 'image/png'"
